TASK_BLURB: Context: this repository belongs to our machine learning team. It is the text-augmentation pipeline that the team uses to evaluate the binary text classifier that screens incoming texts before they reach our deployed assistant. It turns seed texts into paraphrase and noise variants so we can measure how robust the classifier is to rewording, and the robustness numbers go into the quarterly review before the next update.
DOMAIN_LINE: This package generates paraphrase and noise variants of seed texts.
USE_LINE: The team runs the variants through candidate models to measure how robust each model is to rewording of a text.
